The `Reed` shared by the external translation's `Central Land of Reed-Plains` and r87's Reed Bell/Reedwardens is a generic word only (`kojiki-chamberlain-excerpt.md:8-10`; `corpus/fixtures/r87-myth-cluster/entities.json:51-84`), not an adopted name or referent.
